designs.title: 01 · 叠弦
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium fantasy geometric energy BOW redesign concept plate, part of a coherent collection. Reference image is STYLE AND GRIP DESIGN LANGUAGE ONLY: favorite C flowing spine, its continuous forked ribbons merging into an ergonomic handhold. Invent a new full bow and matching close-up as specified below, do not reproduce reference bow wholesale. Landscape 3:2 dark charcoal presentation. LEFT HALF a large complete bow in near-side orthographic view, upper and lower tips and a taut single bowstring entirely visible with margins; RIGHT HALF an enlarged three-quarter view of the SAME central grip and limb roots, no disagreement between views. Elegant precise solid-light geometry with substantial thick cross sections, deep red planes and fine scarlet emissive edges, moderate fluorescence with VERY restrained glow. No metal, leather, crystal rock texture, jewelry, engravings or photoreal props. Clean smooth polygonal planes. Bow grip is a comfortable substantial palm-length structural waist merging seamlessly with limb rails, curved split/bifurcated transitions and purposeful open negative space above/below hand, inspired by favorite flowing spine. Preserve arrow passage, don't put sharp fins inside palm. Full limbs must be formed from SIMPLE REPEATED GEOMETRIC SHAPES graduating in size along a graceful bow arc, not generic ornate fantasy carving. Distinctive silhouette, refined economical geometry suitable as modeling reference. No stars, hexagrams, seals, medallions, hands or characters. A few tiny red particles beside limb tips only, no large aura. One small title exactly as supplied, no other labels. Full bow must remain a visually important hero, not a tiny thumbnail. Title: "01 · 叠弦". Reimagine the layered triangle bow. Strong broad sweep, each limb built from 9 to 11 broad short triangular plates stepping and overlapping like a graceful geometric feather along TWO substantial flowing structural ribbons. Big plates near root progressively smaller at tip, generous gaps revealing rhythm. Grip develops from these paired flowing ribbons into a solid smooth waist; above and below the palm, the ribbons open into long tapered teardrop voids. Two SHORT offset wedge shoulder fins echo plate rhythm outside hand space, inspired by interlocking vanes but clean and comfortable. Heroic sturdy silhouette, strong triangular outer edge, smooth inner arc; absolutely not hair-thin wire triangles. Coherent top/bottom balance.

Title: "02 · 六垣". Reimagine the hexagon chain bow. Architectural, open, powerful. Each gently recurved limb consists of 7 to 9 thick hollow hexagonal frames graduating large at root to small at tip. Frames joined into a continuous strong crescent with a flowing structural rail along their inner edges, generous readable hexagonal holes. The hexagonal frames nearer the grip stretch gradually into elongated faceted loops that flow INTO the substantial curved palm grip, so no abrupt glued-on grip. Compact split elliptical shoulder arcs are structurally continuous around elongated negative spaces just above/below the hand, evoking broken orbit idea very subtly, never a circular shield. Main grip clean solid waist, no ornament floating in its center. Large rounder bow silhouette with polygon rhythm, precise and serene.

Title: "03 · 方旋". Reimagine rotating square bow. Each limb has 8 to 10 THICK hollow square frames following an S-recurve, squares gradually change angle in shallow 3D like a measured helix with bigger frames near root and small at tips. Distinguish SQUARES from long rhombi: roughly equal diagonals and right-angle corners. Two flowing flattened structural ribbons thread through one edge of frames to support them. At grip, square corners stretch into sweeping flattened bands: a subtle shallow twist merges two ribbons into a substantial smooth ergonomic palm waist and bifurcates below it; open offset rectangular-to-teardrop transitions above and below palm. Bold spatial depth yet simple broad planes, no chaotic crisscross, no thin wire. Small stepped shoulders reminiscent of interlocking vanes blended into the flow. Compact angular recurved profile.

Title: "04 · 流菱". Reimagine elongated diamond bow. The most elegant streamlined proposal, closest to favorite flowing-spine grip. Two broad fluid flattened bands sweep continuously the ENTIRE length of a long slender recurve, separating and rejoining to form 6 to 8 long narrow DIAMOND-shaped openings per limb, each opening about 3 times longer than wide, progressively small toward tips.
